evals.prompt:
请一次性同时调研以下多篇论文并输出 Cross-Paper Analysis：
- https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam2 
- https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.14035 
- 3D gaussian splatting for real-time radiance field rendering
evals.expected_output: A mixed-input multi-paper run (GitHub repo URL + arXiv URL + title) under .sisyphus/evidence/<run-id>/ with normalized paper identities, per-paper source/report artifacts, verifier evidence for Step 2/3, and merged Cross-Paper Analysis with merge provenance
expectations: A new run directory is created under .sisyphus/evidence/<run-id>/ and all artifacts stay inside that run directory
All three heterogeneous inputs (repository URL, paper URL, paper title) are resolved to concrete paper identities before delegation
Step 1 is accepted by orchestrator: registry.json is parseable and all tracked fields are initialized to empty string (not processed)
registry.json exists and contains deterministic short-title entries for all requested papers
Registry entries do not collapse different input types into a single paper unless identity resolution evidence proves they are the same work
Each paper directory contains source.pdf and source.txt, and source.txt is plain-text transcription of source.pdf (not a summary)
Each paper directory contains required report.md before finalization
Delegation outputs include verifier PASS/FAIL evidence for both Step 2 and Step 3
Step 3 verifier evidence confirms schema order and PDF-read-before-summary grounding for each paper
Each paper is processed in its own delegated task with PAPER_COUNT: 1
Metadata-only summary is rejected; per-paper reporting must be grounded in downloaded PDF content
Final response includes merge provenance with input report paths, merge order, and merged output path
Step 4 finalize gate is enforced: merged output is allowed only after per-paper report existence and final registry sync PASS
Registry fields use correct semantics: empty=not processed, none=not found, path/URL=found
Run verdict follows contract: APPROVE only when all steps pass (or allowed NA), otherwise REJECT
